explanation: Induction head that fires on any token whose same token already appeared earlier in the context, attending to the token that followed that earlier copy. It is strongest (about 0.4-0.9 of max) on the second occurrence of a rare word split into several pieces (unusual name, place, acronym, nonce word or code identifier such as AMOC, Telgemeier, Rhosbeirio, sinix), peaking on its first or middle pieces. Repeated common content words, repeated phrases, repeated random letter strings and repeated code tokens are weak-to-moderately active (about 0.25-0.5; the more often or longer the repeat, the higher). Text in which no content word or word piece recurs is near zero (about 0.01), as are first occurrences, and repeats of only function words ('the', 'said that') or a single short common name repeated once (Bob, John) stay below about 0.2.
